goal: Detect unexpected outbound network and DNS traffic generated during CI test execution
Prevent tests from leaking test environment data or violating test hermeticity
reviewability: A new review may wait a long time for a response
agreement: Broad concept approval and code review ACKs (ryanofsky, fjahr, 0xB10C)
Verified by testing on CI runners with external DNS configurations (0xB10C, fjahr)
Nonblocking objection: tcpdump direction flag is a no-op when reading capture files (fjahr)
Concurred the direction flag is a harmless no-op but worth addressing (ryanofsky)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because automated monitoring catches unintended external network requests during CI runs
Improves CI runner hermeticity without altering build behavior

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because it enforces isolation across unit, functional, and fuzz test suites
Catches test suites that leak queries to the public internet, though it is non-critical and deferrable
